revision.why: a staged diagnosis showed that 6 of the 8 Graph3D conversion failures were implementation settings, not molecule limitations, and that the Identity pair builder had been substituting replacement pairs for molecules it could not render.
what_changed: Graph3D: two documented fallbacks added, reached ONLY when the declared rule produces no usable conformer (random-coordinate embedding; extended iteration cap). Every payload the declared rule already produced is byte-identical.
Identity: the pair list is now decided before any rendering, so all eight representations answer the same pairs and an unrenderable pair is reported rather than swapped.
revision.superseded: the v1 analysis, the v1 frozen manifest and the v1 item lists are kept under 99_archive_v1_196/ and extension_manifest_v1.json; the v1 numbers are NOT silently replaced.

reuse.reason: main-02 and extension-01 were produced by the same model, provider, endpoint and generation settings
reuse._reuse_conditions_checked: prompt text for the same item, model id, provider, endpoint, generation settings and scoring version
reuse._weight_caveat: an identical model alias does not prove identical backend weights; the service returned no version or fingerprint, so the backend revision is NOT claimed to be fixed

metric_definitions.t2_functional_groups: 子结构 Macro-F1（固定 10 标签）

representation_note: img is a picture (pixels). Graph2D and Graph3D are MOL V2000 connection tables read as TEXT: they are not pictures and not graph neural networks, and the two differ only in where the coordinates come from, so Graph3D is an extra-information condition. CML and MolJSON differ from them in serialisation (XML and JSON). The five added representations are five ways of writing the SAME molecule to ONE general model; they are not five prediction models.

strict_common_subset.note: items answered by EVERY representation in the table; recomputed per item, with the 10-label macro-F1 set unchanged. Graph3D cannot express a few molecules, so this is the set on which all eight rows are strictly comparable. It is reported ALONGSIDE the full-coverage table, not instead of it, and no molecule was swapped to reach a round number.

inference_status.t1_identity: descriptive only. The view a molecule is drawn in is fixed by slot in this stage, but the shared-endpoint dependence is still not resolved by a method this project has validated, so no confirmatory claim is made.
inference_status.t2_functional_groups: reported with the fixed 10-label set, paired, Holm-corrected
inference_status.t3_atom_counts: reported; items are single molecules, clusters are singletons
inference_status.t4_qed: reported; lower is better, so a positive difference means the left arm is worse

family.correction: Holm-Bonferroni within the task family, family size fixed at 9

multiplicity._untested_handling: an untested pair keeps its place in the family; the Holm divisor is not reduced to the pairs that were computable
multiplicity._old_p_values: the previous stage corrected over a family of 3. Those values are NOT reused here and are not presented as extension results

analysis_note: Every number in the report is read from this file. Point estimates are descriptive and do not depend on any significance result; an interval containing 0 means no difference was DETECTED at this sample size, which is not the same as equivalence.
